QuestInfo.name: [Halloween] Olivia: 'Help Me'
QuestInfo.0: The poor girl standing outside the mansion looks so frightened and alone. Let's see what she needs help with.
QuestInfo.1: Olivia will not return inside to the Mansion until the #b100 Rotting Skeletons#k are defeated.
QuestInfo.2: The #b100 Rotting Skeletons#k have been defeated. Olivia is now able to enter her home, but this might just be the beginning.

0.0: I just went outside to play, trying to catch some pretty butterflies, when suddenly some horrible-looking zombies and ghosts snuck into our house. Now my daddy's trapped inside and I can't go back because these monsters are guarding the gate! Please help me return to my family!

yes.0: You will? Thank you so much! Now, if you could defeat #b100 Rotting Skeletons#k then I might just be willing to take a step in there. I believe in you!

no.0: What...? You're going to abandon this scared, lonely little girl? You have no heart!

1.0: Can you rid the house of zombies and ghosts? I'm afraid to go inside alone.

yes.0: Oh, I'm so grateful to you. For a minute, I thought you'd never return. I hope Daddy and my doll collection are still intact.

mob.0: I don't think I can go back inside yet. I still see those #b100 Rotting Skeletons#k lurking around the corner.
